hypothesis: ES's RTH 09:35 -> 15:55 move is positive on sessions of the monthly option-expiration week and negative on sessions of the following week: long OpEx-week sessions and short the week after, 1:1 at 0.5 x ATR20, beats side-matched random-timing twins on the same sessions with the same bracket.
mechanism: Dealer hedge rebalancing and the unwind of option-related positions around monthly expiration: option-active large caps rise in expiration week and give part of it back the week after (Stivers & Sun); for the index the post-OpEx weakness is practitioner-documented.

Practitioner: S&P 500 quarterly-expiration weeks averaged -0.23% since 2013, other expiration weeks ~breakeven - contradicts a long OpEx-week leg in-sample for our splits.

timestamp_semantics: Uses only today's date (bar['day']) and the published calendar rules (known years in advance); no price input except the controller's ATR20 bracket from bar['hist'] (prior sessions) and the slot 0 close as the bracket centre. The sandbox has no datetime, so the strategy does integer day arithmetic and carries its own copy of the evaluator's NYSE holiday rule; a test checks it equals research_loop_daily.eval.data.nyse_holidays for 2010-2027.
features: F = the third Friday of today's calendar month (day 15-21). OpEx week W0 = the calendar days F-4 .. F (Monday..Friday); following week W1 = F+3 .. F+7. Both always lie in today's month (F+7 <= 28).

Scheduled sessions of a window = its weekdays that are not NYSE rule holidays (published rule, identical to the evaluator's nyse_holidays; ad hoc closures are not anticipated: none falls in any window 2011-2026). If F itself is a holiday (Good Friday 2014-04-18, 2019-04-19, 2022-04-15, 2025-04-18; Juneteenth 2026-06-19) W0 is unchanged and its last scheduled session is the Thursday, the actual expiration day.
Position within a window counts scheduled sessions including half days (a half day takes a slot but is never traded).

rules.bars: 5m RTH bars; decision on slot 0's close (09:35), market fill at the next bar's open (09:35); the engine manages the bracket.
rules.sessions: skip NYSE half days (today); skip sessions where ATR20(tr) over the last 20 hist entries is not computable (controller rule). Sessions missing from the data (2014-09-23..25 inside a dev window) simply have no trade.
rules.entry: full_weeks: side = +1 on every session in W0, -1 on every session in W1. 3_sessions: side = +1 on the last 3 scheduled sessions of W0, -1 on the first 3 scheduled sessions of W1. Otherwise no trade. One trade per session at most.
rules.risk: stop = c0 - side * k * ATR20, target = c0 + side * k * ATR20, c0 = slot 0 close, ATR20 = mean of the last 20 hist 'tr', k = 0.5. Controller-enforced.
rules.exit: stop, target, or the engine's flat at the 15:55 open.
